package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"
	"golang.org/x/time/rate"
)

// scenario for go_perf_layer_resource_pooling_rate_limiter_per_request: Layer: Resource pooling. Flag rate limiter construction inside request handlers instead of per identity or dependency.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.

func HandleAPI(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	limiter := rate.NewLimiter(rate.Limit(100), 10)
	if !limiter.Allow() {
		http.Error(w, "rate limited", http.StatusTooManyRequests)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	w.Write([]byte(`{"status":"ok"}`))
}
